nodes.description: Immutable IERC20 liquidity asset held in escrow by the FundingLocker.
Immutable loan address authorized to call pull and drain.
FundingLocker constructor sets liquidityAsset and loan.
Modifier that requires msg.sender to equal the loan address.
Transfers a specified amount of liquidity asset to a destination; only the loan can call it.
Transfers the entire liquidity asset balance to the loan; only the loan can call it.
Caller address used in the isLoan access control check.
External token transfer executed by pull via SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
External token transfer executed by drain via SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
Constructor parameter for the liquidity asset address.
Constructor parameter for the loan address.
Local variable in drain holding the full liquidityAsset balance of this contract.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns _liquidityAsset to liquidityAsset.
Constructor assigns _loan to loan.
Constructor parameter _liquidityAsset initializes liquidityAsset.
Constructor parameter _loan initializes loan.
msg.sender is compared against loan in the isLoan require.
loan state variable is used in the isLoan access control check.
isLoan modifier gates execution of pull.
isLoan modifier gates execution of drain.
pull calls liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(dst, amt).
liquidityAsset token instance is used for the pull transfer.
dst parameter is passed to the pull transfer.
amt parameter is passed as the pull transfer amount.
External token transfer in pull may call back into the contract.
drain calls liquidityAsset.safeTransfer(loan, amt).
liquidityAsset token instance is used for the drain transfer.
loan address is the recipient of the drain transfer.
Local amt variable is passed as the drain transfer amount.
drain computes amt from liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)).
External token transfer in drain may call back into the contract.
drain reads liquidityAsset.balanceOf(address(this)).

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter used directly to initialize liquidityAsset state variable.
Constructor parameter used directly to initialize loan state variable.
pull parameter directly passed to the token transfer.
pull parameter directly passed as the token transfer amount.
drain local variable directly holds the amount transferred to the loan.
